findings.claim: APG modal-dialog guidance calls for moving focus into the dialog on open, containing Tab and Shift+Tab within it, closing on Escape, and returning focus to the invoking control when the dialog closes (unless workflow conditions justify another destination). aria-modal=true is appropriate only when outside content is actually unavailable to all users and visually obscured.
findings.proposed_rule: For a lightbox implemented as a modal dialog, verify its runtime behavior against APG focus containment, Escape dismissal, focus restoration, accessible naming, and actual modality; do not infer conformance from role/aria-modal markup alone.
findings.scope: Static JavaScript photo lightbox at the cited project revision.
findings.non_goals: This source review does not certify implementation behavior, assistive-technology interoperability, or browser-specific reliability.

sources.evidence: Opened as turn45view0. findings.claim: APG carousel guidance requires user control for automatically rotating carousels, including stopping/restarting rotation; rotation stops when focus enters and does not restart without explicit request. MDN documents inert as removing an element subtree from focus/click interaction, tab order, and accessibility tree; modal dialog elements opened with showModal() are a special exception to inherited inertness. The current team scroller is user-controlled and does not automatically rotate, so automatic-rotation requirements do not apply to that behavior.
findings.proposed_rule: Keep non-visible/background content genuinely non-interactive while the lightbox is open and restore each element's prior inert state on close; assess carousel auto-rotation requirements only if automatic rotation is introduced.
findings.scope: Static JavaScript lightbox background handling and team horizontal scroller at the cited project revision.
findings.non_goals: MDN's broad availability statement is documentation evidence, not a test of the project's supported browser matrix. The team scroller is not claimed to implement the APG carousel pattern fully.

findings.claim: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.2.2 vyžaduje ovládanie pause/stop/hide pre automaticky spustený pohyb, blikanie alebo rolovanie, ktoré trvá viac než päť sekúnd a je súbežné s iným obsahom, pokiaľ pohyb nie je súčasťou činnosti, kde je nevyhnutný. SC 1.4.2 vyžaduje pri automatickom zvuku dlhšom než tri sekundy buď mechanizmus na jeho pozastavenie/zastavenie, alebo nezávislé ovládanie hlasitosti oproti celkovej hlasitosti systému. SC 2.3.3 pre interakciou spustenú animáciu je úroveň AAA a umožňuje výnimku, ak je animácia nevyhnutná pre funkčnosť alebo informáciu; nejde o všeobecnú AA požiadavku. Špecifikácia tu nepredpisuje framework ani prefers-reduced-motion API.

confidence.reason: Normatívne W3C WCAG 2.2 Recommendation otvorená priamo; príslušné kritériá a ich úrovne sú explicitne uvedené.

applicability.environment: Barbershop: static HTML/CSS/ES modules and WebGL; no React, GSAP, or three.js.

findings.proposed_rule: Pri automatickom pohybe nad 5 sekúnd súbežnom s obsahom poskytnúť ovládanie pause/stop/hide, okrem pohybu nevyhnutného pre danú činnosť. Pri automatickom zvuku nad 3 sekundy ponúknuť pause/stop alebo ovládanie hlasitosti nezávislé od celkovej systémovej hlasitosti. Pri interakciou spustenej animácii zachovať správnu úroveň WCAG a výnimku pre animáciu nevyhnutnú pre funkčnosť alebo informáciu; prefers-reduced-motion možno podporiť ako doplnkovú systémovú preferenciu, ale táto stránka ju výslovne nešpecifikuje.
findings.scope: Požiadavky na prístupnosť relevantné pre pohyb a zvuk v statickom webe.
findings.non_goals: Nedokazuje implementačný stav projektu, WCAG zhodu, ani novú zmenu dokumentu od 20.10.; neurčuje API pre konkrétnu WebGL knižnicu.

findings.claim: Ak sa komponent správa ako automaticky rotujúci carousel, APG odporúča ovládanie zastavenia/spustenia, zastavenie pri vstupe klávesnicového fokusu bez automatického obnovenia, kým ho používateľ výslovne nevyžiada, a zastavenie pri hoveri. APG vysvetľuje vzor widgetu; samo osebe nie je certifikát WCAG zhody.

Zachovať prístupný stav a ovládanie pri zmene prefers-reduced-motion; APG túto mediálnu preferenciu samo výslovne nekonkretizuje.

findings.non_goals: Nedokazuje, že projekt obsahuje carousel; nie je všeobecným predpisom pre každý pohyb v WebGL ani dokladom WCAG zhody.

researcher_record.routing_reason: Authorized bounded primary-source research for security and recovery; one OWASP page and two GitHub REST documentation pages, matched to the reported Git Data API use.
researcher_record.delta_from_baseline: Current source review is consistent with the 2026-10-20 OWASP baseline (least privilege, default denial, per-request checks). GitHub documents confirm the reported X-GitHub-Api-Version 2026-03-10 pin as currently supported, and confirm force:false as the non-overwriting fast-forward mode. No new source-backed rule or deprecation affecting the reported implementation was identified. This is a documentation comparison, not a code or security assessment.

findings.claim: OWASP recommends least privilege and default denial, authorization checks for each request, and says client-side checks must not be the decisive authorization control. A client-side static admin should therefore not be treated as the security boundary; authorization for Git writes must be enforced by GitHub and the credential must be appropriately scoped.
findings.proposed_rule: Candidate check: establish whether the GitHub credential is ever exposed to browser code and confirm that GitHub-side repository permissions, rather than UI checks, gate writes. Apply least privilege and default denial to any server-side or GitHub App authorization layer in scope.
findings.scope: Static HTML/CSS/ES modules/WebGL admin reported to use GitHub Git Data API; applicability of an authorization service or GitHub App is unknown.
findings.non_goals: Does not establish whether the project exposes a credential, which credential type is configured, or whether its authorization is secure. No privacy, cache, or recovery implementation claim is made.

confidence.reason: Directly read official OWASP guidance; project-specific exposure and configuration were not independently inspected.

checks.method: Opened the OWASP Authorization Cheat Sheet and inspected its recommendations on least privilege, default denial, per-request authorization, client-side checks, and testing.
checks.result: Documentation confirms the recommendations; no project runtime or credential test was performed.

findings.claim: GitHub's Update a reference endpoint requires Contents repository write permission for fine-grained tokens. The `force` parameter defaults to false; omitted or false ensures the update is fast-forward and does not overwrite work. The endpoint documents HTTP 409 conflict and 422 validation/spam responses.
findings.proposed_rule: Candidate check: retain `force:false`, handle conflict/validation failures without retrying as a force update, and verify the configured token has only the necessary repository scope. Exercise denied and stale/non-fast-forward cases only in an authorized test repository.
findings.scope: Reported admin code uses GitHub Git Data API, compares the current head and requests PATCH with force:false; research did not inspect the file itself or make a remote request.
findings.non_goals: Does not prove the head comparison is race-free, that the token is minimally scoped, or that branch protection/other repository policy is configured.

confidence.reason: Directly read the official endpoint reference, including the update permission, force default and response codes; project details are supplied as static observations by N16.

findings.claim: GitHub's API Versions documentation lists 2026-03-10 and 2022-11-28 as currently supported as observed on 2026-10-21. It recommends the X-GitHub-Api-Version header; requests omitting the header default to 2022-11-28. The docs identify 2026-03-10 as released 2026-03-10.
findings.proposed_rule: Candidate check: keep the explicit version header and periodically compare the pinned version with GitHub's supported-version list and breaking-change notes before changing it.
findings.scope: Reported admin GitHub API client pins X-GitHub-Api-Version 2026-03-10.
findings.non_goals: The supported-version list is time-sensitive and not a guarantee of future support. Research did not send an API request or verify the runtime header.

confidence.reason: The official API-version page explicitly lists supported versions and header behavior; applies to the version reported by N16.
